title: Power Monitoring and Alarms
summary: Use voltage, current, load, UPS, battery, and alarm data as evidence.
objectives: Distinguish an alarm from a confirmed cause.

vocab.def: Collected measurements or status information about a system.
A signal that a condition requires attention in a defined context.
The portion of a resource currently in use.

sections.heading: Alarms are clues
sections.body: A UPS warning or high load value signals attention, but it does not prove the root cause. Compare timestamps, path status, and recent events.

practice.prompt: A current alarm appears while voltage is normal and a redundant path is available. What follows?
practice.answer: Record the signals, compare the path evidence, and escalate safely without touching equipment.

reflectionPrompt: Which signal was observation and which conclusion remained uncertain?
